title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
slides: YouTube wants AI to design your feed now?
You'll describe your ideal recommendations in plain words
But the AI might ignore your stated preferences
Your feed could change based on daily prompts
Try one prompt: what do you actually want to watch?
thread_text:
1. Your Feed, Your Words

YouTube is building a feature where you type what you want to watch. It's part of a bigger bet on AI-driven recommendations.

2. The AI Might Ignore You

Even if you describe your ideal feed, the system can override your input based on engagement signals. Your words are a suggestion, not a command.

3. Daily Prompts, Daily Feed

Imagine waking up and typing a prompt to reshape your recommendations. Your feed could shift every day based on your mood.

4. A Test Prompt for You

Try asking yourself: what do I actually want to watch? Then see if YouTube's current algorithm delivers it.

5. Try It Yourself

Open YouTube and search for a niche topic you love. If the recommendations don't match, the AI isn't listening yet.

instagram.caption:
You type what you want to watch, and the algorithm builds it.

YouTube is working on an AI feature that lets you describe your ideal recommendations in plain words.

The catch: the system can still override your input based on engagement signals. Your words are a suggestion, not a command. 🤖

Your feed could change daily based on a prompt you write that morning.

If you publish videos, discovery may stop depending on tags and start depending on whether the AI trusts your audience's behavior. 📉

What would you type right now to fix your recommendations?
